caption: The drawing depicts a wooden rocking horse positioned in a three-quarter view, facing left, against a plain, off-white background. The horse is rendered in brown tones, with darker brown and black markings to indicate features such as the eyes, nose, and mane. The body of the horse is decorated with several black circles containing red centers. The legs are straight and angled, with visible wood grain and some areas of lighter shading to suggest wear. A short, simple tail, rendered with thin, grayish black strokes, is affixed to the back of the horse. The saddle area is painted in a muted green with a faded, frayed cushion that has red and beige stripes on the backrest. There are no additional objects or background elements, and the artist’s signature appears in the lower right corner.
title: Hobby Horse
